content: Service Name Fr Ar Tp_ Change Parameter Syntax Std_ Return Type Fr Ar Tp_ Change Parameter ( Pdu Id Type id, TPParameter Type parameter, uint16 value ) Service ID [hex] 0x4b Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) id Identification of the PDU which the parameter change shall affect. parameter ID of the parameter that shall be changed. value The new value of the parameter. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: The parameter was changed successfully. E_ NOT_ OK: The parameter change was rejected. Description Request to change a specific transport protocol parameter (e.g. block size). Available via Fr Ar Tp.h
